serverInfo.name: m2m-sentinel
serverInfo.description: Base bytecode capability observations, proxy resolution, gas, DEX, and transfer telemetry.

sse.description: Legacy HTTP+SSE compatibility transport for 2024-11-05 clients.

authentication.description: The transport is discoverable without a credential. Payable tool calls require an API key or a valid x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE at the API execution layer.

tools.name: m2m_audit_contract
tools.description: Return selected static bytecode capability observations, common proxy resolution, limitations, and provenance for a Base contract. This is factual capability observation, not a safety or exploitability guarantee.

tools.name: m2m_get_gas_metrics
tools.description: Return sourced Base gas fee metrics and execution recommendations.

tools.name: m2m_get_token_price
tools.description: Return sourced Base DEX token price observation for allowlisted assets (e.g. USDC, WETH).

tools.name: m2m_get_dex_liquidity
tools.description: Return tracked Base DEX pool reserve, depth, and volume metrics.

tools.name: m2m_get_whale_signals
tools.description: Return tracked Base whale transfer and concentration signals with source provenance.

tools.name: m2m_get_service_status
tools.description: Return real-time operational status of M2M Sentinel upstream RPC, persistence, and verification rails.
